app.title: Josh's Tacos
app.description: Order Josh's Tacos for pickup by text message.
howto: Add items, then text your order. Josh's Tacos confirms price, pickup time & availability.
menu.heading: Menu
desc.combo-taco: 3 ground beef tacos, white rice, sweet tea
desc.combo-big: 5 ground beef tacos, white rice, sweet tea
desc.combo-sides: 3 ground beef tacos, white rice, juicy beans, mini bag of chips, sweet tea
desc.combo-full: 5 ground beef tacos, white rice, juicy beans, mini bag of chips, sweet tea
maria.text: Ask about it! It isn't priced in the app. Josh's Tacos will tell you about it.
cart.heading: Your order
cart.empty: Your order is empty. Add something from the menu.
cart.note: Seller confirms price, pickup time & availability
composer.heading: Send your order
composer.name: Your name (optional)
composer.how: Your messages app opens with this order filled in. Review it and press Send yourself. Nothing is sent automatically.
composer.fallback: If your messages app doesn't open, call or copy the order summary.
order.name: Name: {name}.
error.copy: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
error.empty: Add at least one item, or tick “Ask about the Maria Special”.
error.menu: The menu couldn't load. Check your connection and try again.
error.storage: Your order can't be saved on this device, so it may be lost if you close the app.
share.heading: Share this link
share.manual: Copy this link and send it to a friend:
install.heading: Add Josh's Tacos to your home screen
install.web: Josh's Tacos is a web app. Your browser adds it to your home screen, so there is no app store and no app file to download.
install.android.3: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.apple.2: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow).
install.launch: Then open it from your home screen. It opens like an app, without the browser's address bar.
update.deferred: Update downloaded. It will apply when you close this window.
update.error: Couldn't check for updates. Try again when you're online.
update.unsupported: Automatic updates aren't supported in this browser.
offline: Offline — prices may be out of date. Confirm with the seller.
contact: Call or text to place your order: {phone}
